translations.idiomatic: When Juyi first topped the policy examination and entered the Hanlin, an enlightened sovereign singled him out for favor and he burned to repay it—hoping to reach the council chamber and benefit the people at once. His intent never ripened; those in power read the wind and crowded him out until he drifted on rivers and lakes.

sentences.zh: 四五年間，幾淪蠻瘴。

translations.literal: Within four or five years he nearly succumbed to miasma in the southern wilds.
translations.idiomatic: Within four or five years he nearly succumbed to miasma in the southern wilds.

sentences.zh: 自是宦情衰落，無意於出處，唯以逍遙自得，吟詠情性為事。

translations.literal: From this his official ambition declined and he had no mind for advancement or withdrawal, taking only free roaming and self-contentment and chanting to express his nature as his affairs.
translations.idiomatic: From this his official ambition declined and he had no mind for advancement or withdrawal, taking only free roaming and self-contentment and chanting to express his nature as his affairs.

sentences.zh: 太和已後，李宗閔、李德裕朋黨事起，是非排陷，朝升暮黜，天子亦無如之何。

translations.literal: After Taihe, the factional affairs of Li Zongmin and Li Deyu arose; right and wrong were used to entrap one another, and men were elevated at dawn and demoted at dusk—the Son of Heaven likewise could do nothing about it.
translations.idiomatic: After Taihe, the factional affairs of Li Zongmin and Li Deyu arose; right and wrong were used to entrap one another, and men were elevated at dawn and demoted at dusk—the Son of Heaven likewise could do nothing about it.

sentences.zh: 楊穎士、楊虞卿與宗閔善，居易妻，穎士從父妹也。

translations.literal: Yang Yingshi and Yang Yuqing were friendly with Zongmin; Juyi's wife was Yingshi's cousin on the father's side.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yingshi and Yang Yuqing were friendly with Zongmin; Juyi's wife was Yingshi's cousin on the father's side.

sentences.zh: 居易愈不自安，懼以黨人見斥，乃求致身散地，冀於遠害。

translations.literal: Juyi grew all the more ill at ease, fearing rejection as a faction member, and sought to place himself in a scattered post, hoping to escape harm from afar.
translations.idiomatic: Juyi grew all the more ill at ease, fearing rejection as a faction member, and sought to place himself in a scattered post, hoping to escape harm from afar.

sentences.zh: 凡所居官，未嘗終秩，率以病免，固求分務，識者多之。

translations.literal: In every office he held he never completed a full term, generally leaving on grounds of illness, firmly requesting duty-at-large posts—those who understood approved of this.
translations.idiomatic: In every office he held he never completed a full term, generally leaving on grounds of illness, firmly requesting duty-at-large posts—those who understood approved of this.

sentences.zh: 五年，除河南尹。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed metropolitan intendant of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed metropolitan intendant of Henan.

sentences.zh: 七年，復授太子賓客分司。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was again appointed Mentor to the Heir Apparent with duty at large.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was again appointed Mentor to the Heir Apparent with duty at large.

sentences.zh: 初，居易罷杭州，歸洛陽。

translations.literal: At first, when Juyi left Hangzhou, he returned to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Juyi left Hangzhou, he returned to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 於履道里得故散騎常侍楊憑宅，竹木池館，有林泉之致。

translations.literal: At Lüdao Lane he obtained the former residence of the Regular Attendant Yang Ping, with bamboo, trees, ponds, and lodges possessing the charm of forests and springs.
translations.idiomatic: At Lüdao Lane he obtained the former residence of the Regular Attendant Yang Ping, with bamboo, trees, ponds, and lodges possessing the charm of forests and springs.

sentences.zh: 家妓樊素、蠻子者，能歌善舞。

translations.literal: His household entertainers Fansu and Manzi could sing and dance well.
translations.idiomatic: His household entertainers Fansu and Manzi could sing and dance well.

sentences.zh: 居易既以尹正罷歸，每獨酌賦詠於舟中，因為《池上篇》曰：

translations.literal: When Juyi had left office as intendant and returned, he often drank alone and composed verses in his boat, and therefore wrote "On the Pond," which read:
translations.idiomatic: After leaving the intendant's post he would drink alone in his boat and compose verses, producing "On the Pond," which begins:

sentences.zh: 又效陶潛《五柳先生傳》，作《醉吟先生傳》以自況。

translations.literal: He also modeled Tao Qian's "Biography of the Five-Willow Gentleman" and composed "Biography of the Drunken Chanting Gentleman" to portray himself.
translations.idiomatic: He also modeled Tao Qian's "Biography of the Five-Willow Gentleman" and composed "Biography of the Drunken Chanting Gentleman" to portray himself.

sentences.zh: 文章曠達，皆此類也。

translations.literal: His writing was free and far-reaching—all of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: His writing was free and far-reaching—all of this kind.

sentences.zh: 太和末，李訓構禍，衣冠塗地，士林傷感，居易愈無宦情。

translations.literal: At the end of Taihe, Li Xun engineered disaster; the gentry were trampled in blood and scholars grieved deeply; Juyi's official ambition declined all the more.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Taihe, Li Xun engineered disaster; the gentry were trampled in blood and scholars grieved deeply; Juyi's official ambition declined all the more.

sentences.zh: 開成元年，除同州刺史，辭疾不拜。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaicheng he was appointed governor of Tongzhou but declined on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaicheng he was appointed governor of Tongzhou but declined on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 尋授太子少傅，進封馮翊縣開國侯。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and advanced to enfeoffment as Marquis of Fengyi with an opening fief.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and advanced to enfeoffment as Marquis of Fengyi with an opening fief.

sentences.zh: 四年冬，得風病，伏枕者累月，乃放諸妓女樊、蠻等，仍自為墓誌，病中吟詠不輟。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fourth year he contracted wind illness and lay on his pillow for months; he then released the entertainers Fan and Man and others, and even composed his own epitaph, chanting without cease even in illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fourth year he contracted wind illness and lay on his pillow for months; he then released the entertainers Fan and Man and others, and even composed his own epitaph, chanting without cease even in illness.

sentences.zh: 自言曰：「予年六十有八，始患風痹之疾，體郤首胘，左足不支。

translations.literal: He said to himself: "I am sixty-eight years old and have first contracted wind-block illness; my body is bent and my head droops, and my left foot cannot support me.
translations.idiomatic: He said to himself, "I am sixty-eight years old and have first contracted wind-block illness; my body is bent and my head droops, and my left foot cannot support me.

sentences.zh: 蓋老病相乘，有時而至耳。

translations.literal: It is that old age and illness multiply, and sometimes arrive together.
translations.idiomatic: It is that old age and illness multiply, and sometimes arrive together.

sentences.zh: 予棲心釋梵，浪跡老、莊，因疾觀身，果有所得。

translations.literal: I have set my mind on Buddhist teaching and wandered in the tracks of Laozi and Zhuangzi; through illness I have observed the body and truly gained something.
translations.idiomatic: I have set my mind on Buddhist teaching and wandered in the tracks of Laozi and Zhuangzi; through illness I have observed the body and truly gained something.

sentences.zh: 何則？

translations.literal: How so?
translations.idiomatic: How so?

sentences.zh: 外形骸而內忘憂患，先禪觀而後順醫治。

translations.literal: Outwardly I discard the bodily form and inwardly forget worry and calamity; first Chan contemplation and afterward compliance with medical treatment.
translations.idiomatic: Outwardly I discard the bodily form and inwardly forget worry and calamity; first Chan contemplation and afterward compliance with medical treatment.

sentences.zh: 旬月以還，厥疾少間，杜門高枕，淡然安閑。

translations.literal: Within a month or so the illness abated somewhat; I shut the gate and lay on a high pillow, calm and at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Within a month or so the illness abated somewhat; I shut the gate and lay on a high pillow, calm and at ease.

sentences.zh: 吟詠興來，亦不能遏，遂為《病中詩》十五篇以自諭。」

translations.literal: When the impulse to chant arose, I could not restrain it either, and therefore composed fifteen "Poems in Illness" to instruct myself."
translations.idiomatic: When the urge to compose returned he could not check it, and wrote fifteen "Poems in Illness" as self-admonition."

sentences.zh: 會昌中，請罷太子少傅，以刑部尚書致仕。

translations.literal: In the Huichang era he requested removal as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and retired as Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huichang era he requested removal as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and retired as Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 與香山僧如滿結香火社，每肩輿往來，白衣鳩杖，自稱香山居士。

translations.literal: He formed a incense-and-fire fellowship with the Xiangshan monk Ruman; each went back and forth in a shoulder carriage, white robe and dove staff, calling himself the Xiangshan Recluse.
translations.idiomatic: He formed a incense-and-fire fellowship with the Xiangshan monk Ruman; each went back and forth in a shoulder carriage, white robe and dove staff, calling himself the Xiangshan Recluse.

sentences.zh: 大中元年卒，時年七十六，贈尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the first year of Dazhong he died at the age of seventy-six and was posthumously enfeoffed as Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Dazhong he died at the age of seventy-six and was posthumously enfeoffed as Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 有文集七十五卷，《經史事類》三十卷，並行於世。

translations.literal: He had a collected works of seventy-five scrolls and Classified Matters from the Classics and Histories of thirty scrolls, and both circulated in his age.
translations.idiomatic: He had a collected works of seventy-five scrolls and Classified Matters from the Classics and Histories of thirty scrolls, and both circulated in his age.

sentences.zh: 長慶末，浙東觀察使元稹，為居易集序曰：

translations.literal: At the end of Changqing, Yuan Zhen, surveillance commissioner of Zhedong, composed a preface for Juyi's collected works, which read:
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Changqing, Yuan Zhen, surveillance commissioner of Zhedong, composed a preface for Juyi's collected works, which read:

sentences.zh: 人以為稹序盡其能事。

translations.literal: People regarded Zhen's preface as exhausting his powers in the task.
translations.idiomatic: People regarded Zhen's preface as exhausting his powers in the task.

sentences.zh: 居易嘗寫其文集，送江州東西二林寺、洛城香山聖善等寺，如佛書雜傳例流行之。

translations.literal: Juyi once copied his collected works and sent them to the eastern and western forest temples of Jiangzhou and to the Xiangshan Shenshan and other temples of Luoyang, circulating them like Buddhist scriptures and miscellaneous transmissions.
translations.idiomatic: Juyi once copied his collected works and sent them to the eastern and western forest temples of Jiangzhou and to the Xiangshan Shenshan and other temples of Luoyang, circulating them like Buddhist scriptures and miscellaneous transmissions.

sentences.zh: 無子，以其侄孫嗣。

translations.literal: He had no son and made his nephew's grandson his heir.
translations.idiomatic: He had no son and made his nephew's grandson his heir.

sentences.zh: 遺命不歸下邽，可葬於香山如滿師塔之側，家人從命而葬焉。

translations.literal: His final instructions were not to return to Xiaji but to be buried beside Master Ruman's pagoda on Xiangshan, and the family followed the command in burying him.
translations.idiomatic: His final instructions were not to return to Xiaji but to be buried beside Master Ruman's pagoda on Xiangshan, and the family followed the command in burying him.

sentences.zh: 弟行簡行簡，字知退。

translations.literal: His younger brother Xingjian, Xingjian, style name Zhitui.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Xingjian, whose courtesy name was Zhitui.

sentences.zh: 貞元末，登進士第，授秘書省校書郎。

translations.literal: At the end of Zhenyuan he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed proofreader in the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Zhenyuan he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed proofreader in the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 元和中，盧坦鎮東蜀，辟為掌書記。

translations.literal: In the Yuanhe era Lu Tan governed eastern Shu and recruited him as recorder.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanhe era Lu Tan governed eastern Shu and recruited him as recorder.

sentences.zh: 府罷，歸潯陽。

translations.literal: When the prefecture was dissolved he returned to Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: When the prefecture was dissolved he returned to Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 居易授江州司馬，從兄之郡。

translations.literal: Juyi was appointed marshal of Jiangzhou and Xingjian accompanied him to the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Juyi was appointed marshal of Jiangzhou and Xingjian accompanied him to the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十五年，居易入朝為尚書郎，行簡亦授左拾遺。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Juyi entered court as a director in a ministry and Xingjian was also appointed Left Reminder.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Juyi entered court as a director in a ministry and Xingjian was also appointed Left Reminder.

sentences.zh: 累遷司門員外郎、主客郎中。

translations.literal: He was promoted in turn to vice director of the Gate Office and director of the Guests Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in turn to vice director of the Gate Office and director of the Guests Bureau.

sentences.zh: 長慶末，振武奏水運營田使賀拔志言營田數過實，詔令行簡按覆之。

translations.literal: At the end of Changqing Zhenwu reported that the water-transport garrison-field commissioner Heba Zhiyan's garrison-field figures greatly exceeded reality; an edict ordered Xingjian to investigate and verify.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Changqing Zhenwu reported that the water-transport garrison-field commissioner Heba Zhiyan's garrison-field figures greatly exceeded reality; an edict ordered Xingjian to investigate and verify.

sentences.zh: 不實，志弘，自刺死。

translations.literal: It was not true; Zhiyan, in alarm, stabbed himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: The report proved false; in alarm Zhiyan stabbed himself to death.

sentences.zh: 行簡寶歷二年冬病卒，有文集一十卷。

translations.literal: Xingjian died of illness in the winter of the second year of Baoli, leaving collected works of ten scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: Xingjian died of illness in the winter of the second year of Baoli, leaving collected works of ten scrolls.

sentences.zh: 行簡文筆有兄風，辭賦尤稱精密，文士皆師法之。

translations.literal: Xingjian's brush had his elder brother's manner, and his fu were especially praised as refined and close; literary men all took him as a model.
translations.idiomatic: Xingjian's brush had his elder brother's manner, and his fu were especially praised as refined and close; literary men all took him as a model.

sentences.zh: 居易友愛過人，兄弟相待如賓客。

translations.literal: Juyi's fraternal affection surpassed others; the brothers treated one another like guests.
translations.idiomatic: Juyi's fraternal affection surpassed others; the brothers treated one another like guests.

sentences.zh: 行簡子龜兒，多自教習，以至成名。

translations.literal: Xingjian's son Guier was largely taught by Juyi himself and thereby achieved fame.
translations.idiomatic: Xingjian's son Guier was largely taught by Juyi himself and thereby achieved fame.

sentences.zh: 當時友悌，無以比焉。

translations.literal: At the time none matched them in fraternal devotion.
translations.idiomatic: At the time none matched them in fraternal devotion.

sentences.zh: 從父弟敏中敏中，字用晦，居易從父弟也。

translations.literal: His younger cousin Minzhong, Minzhong, style name Yonghui, was Juyi's cousin on the father's side.
translations.idiomatic: His younger cousin Minzhong, whose courtesy name was Yonghui, was Juyi's cousin on the father's side.

sentences.zh: 祖鏻，位終揚府錄事參軍。

translations.literal: His grandfather Lian ended his career as recorder of Yang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Lian ended his career as recorder of Yang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父季康，溧陽令。

translations.literal: His father Jikang was magistrate of Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jikang was magistrate of Liyang.

sentences.zh: 敏中少孤，為諸兄之所訓歷。

translations.literal: Minzhong was orphaned young and was trained through experience by his elder brothers.
translations.idiomatic: Minzhong was orphaned young and was trained through experience by his elder brothers.

sentences.zh: 長慶初，登進士第，佐李聽，歷河東、鄭滑、邠寧三府節度掌書記，試大理評事。

translations.literal: In the early Changqing era he passed the jinshi examination, served Li Ting as aide, and in turn was recorder under the military governors of Hedong, Zheng-Hua, and Binning, and tested as reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Changqing era he passed the jinshi examination, served Li Ting as aide, and in turn was recorder under the military governors of Hedong, Zheng-Hua, and Binning, and tested as reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 大和七年，丁母憂，退居下邽。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Dahe he entered mourning for his mother and retired to Xiaji.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Dahe he entered mourning for his mother and retired to Xiaji.

sentences.zh: 會昌初，為殿中侍御史，分司東都。

translations.literal: In the early Huichang era he was palace censor with duty at the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Huichang era he was palace censor with duty at the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 尋除戶部員外郎，還京。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed vice director in the Ministry of Revenue and returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed vice director in the Ministry of Revenue and returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 武宗皇帝素聞居易之名，及即位，欲征用之。

translations.literal: Emperor Wuzong had long heard Juyi's name, and when he ascended the throne wished to summon and employ him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wuzong had long heard Juyi's name, and when he ascended the throne wished to summon and employ him.

sentences.zh: 宰相李德裕言居易衰病，不任朝謁，因言從弟敏中辭藝類居易，即日知制誥，召入翰林充學士，遷中書舍人。

translations.literal: The chief minister Li Deyu said Juyi was aged and ill and unfit for court audience, and therefore spoke of his cousin Minzhong, whose literary arts resembled Juyi's; that same day Minzhong received charge of drafting edicts, was summoned into the Hanlin Academy as academician, was transferred to drafting academician.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister Li Deyu said Juyi was aged and ill and unfit for court audience, and therefore spoke of his cousin Minzhong, whose literary arts resembled Juyi's; that same day Minzhong received charge of drafting edicts, was summoned into the Hanlin Academy as academician, was transferred to drafting academician.

sentences.zh: 累至兵部侍郎、學士承旨。

translations.literal: He was promoted in turn to vice minister of War and chief academician.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in turn to vice minister of War and chief academician.

sentences.zh: 會昌末，同平章事，兼刑部尚書、集賢史館大學士。

translations.literal: At the end of Huichang he was appointed chief councilor with concurrent posts as Minister of Punishments and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and History Office.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Huichang he was appointed chief councilor with concurrent posts as Minister of Punishments and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and History Office.

sentences.zh: 宣宗即位，加右僕射、金紫光祿大夫、太清宮使、太原郡開國公、食邑二千戶。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong ascended the throne, he was added as Right Vice Director, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with golden seal, commissioner of the Great Pure Palace, Duke of Taiyuan with an opening fief of two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong ascended the throne, he was added as Right Vice Director, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with golden seal, commissioner of the Great Pure Palace, Duke of Taiyuan with an opening fief of two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 及李德裕再貶嶺南，敏中居四輔之首，雷同毀譽，無一言伸理，特論罪之。

translations.literal: When Li Deyu was again demoted to the southern mountains, Minzhong stood at the head of the four assistants and echoed the slander without a single word spoken in his defense; he was specially condemned for this crime.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Deyu was banished again to the southern mountains, Minzhong led the four chief ministers and chimed in with the attack, never speaking a word in his defense—a fault for which he was specially censured.

sentences.zh: 五年，罷相，檢校司空，出為邠州刺史、邠寧節度、招撫党項都制置等使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was removed as chief councilor, appointed acting Minister of Works, and sent out as governor of Binzhou with military commission over Binning, commissioner for pacifying the Tangut, and overall disposition.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was removed as chief councilor, appointed acting Minister of Works, and sent out as governor of Binzhou with military commission over Binning, commissioner for pacifying the Tangut, and overall disposition.

sentences.zh: 七年，進位特進、成都尹、劍南西川節度副大使、知節度等事。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he advanced to Special Grand Master, metropolitan intendant of Chengdu, deputy military commissioner of Sword-South West with charge of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he advanced to Special Grand Master, metropolitan intendant of Chengdu, deputy military commissioner of Sword-South West with charge of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月，檢校司徒、平章事、江陵尹、荊南節度使。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eleventh year he was appointed acting Minister of Works, chief councilor, metropolitan intendant of Jiangling, and military commissioner of Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eleventh year he was appointed acting Minister of Works, chief councilor, metropolitan intendant of Jiangling, and military commissioner of Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 懿宗即位，征拜司徒、門下侍郎、平章事，復輔政。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yizong ascended the throne, Minzhong was summoned as Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Gate Department, and chief councilor, again assisting in governance.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yizong took the throne, Minzhong was summoned as Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Gate Department, and chief councilor, returning to assist at court.

sentences.zh: 尋加侍中。

translations.literal: Soon he was added as Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made Palace Attendant as well.

sentences.zh: 三年罷相，為河中尹、河中晉絳節度使。

translations.literal: In the third year he was removed as chief councilor and made metropolitan intendant of Hezhong and military commissioner of Hezhong-Jin-Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he left the chancellorship and became metropolitan intendant of Hezhong and military commissioner of Hezhong-Jin-Jiang.

sentences.zh: 累遷中書令。

translations.literal: He was promoted in turn to drafting director.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in turn to drafting director.

sentences.zh: 太子太師致仕，卒。

translations.literal: He retired as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and died.
translations.idiomatic: He retired as Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and died in office.

sentences.zh: 評贊史臣曰：舉才選士之法，尚矣！

translations.literal: The evaluating historian says: The method of raising talent and selecting scholars is ancient indeed!
translations.idiomatic: The evaluating historian writes: Methods for raising talent and choosing scholars are very old indeed!

sentences.zh: 自漢策賢良，隋加詩賦，罷中正之法，委銓舉之司。

translations.literal: From the Han policy examination for the worthy and good, the Sui added poetry and fu, abolished the method of impartial evaluation, and entrusted selection to the examination offices.
translations.idiomatic: From the Han examination of worthy men through the Sui addition of poetry and fu, the impartial-evaluation system was abandoned and selection entrusted to the examination offices.

sentences.zh: 由是爭務雕蟲，罕趨函丈，矯首皆希於屈、宋，駕肩並擬於《風》、《騷》。

translations.literal: From this men strove for ornamental craft and rarely hastened to the lecture hall; raising their heads all hoped for Qu Yuan and Song Yu, shoulder to shoulder all modeled themselves on the "Airs" and "Elegies."
translations.idiomatic: Candidates then strove for ornamental craft and rarely attended the lecture hall; all craned their necks toward Qu Yuan and Song Yu and marched shoulder to shoulder after the "Airs" and "Elegies."

sentences.zh: 或侔箴闕之篇，或敩補亡之句。

translations.literal: Some matched pieces admonishing the throne, others imitated lines mending what was lost.
translations.idiomatic: Some matched pieces admonishing the throne, others imitated lines mending what was lost.

sentences.zh: 鹹欲錙銖《采葛》，糠秕《懷沙》，較麗藻於碧雞，鬥新奇於白鳳。

translations.literal: All wished to weigh against "Gathering Mugwort," sift chaff from "Lament for Huai," compare ornate phrases with the green cock, and contest novelty with the white phoenix.
translations.idiomatic: Each hoped to measure up to "Gathering Mugwort," sift chaff from "Lament for Huai," rival the green cock in ornament, and outdo the white phoenix in novelty.

sentences.zh: 暨編之簡牘，播在管弦，未逃季緒之詆訶，孰望《子虛》之稱賞？

translations.literal: When compiled in bamboo slips and spread through pipes and strings, they did not escape Ji Xu's censure—who could hope for the praise given "Sir Fantasy"?
translations.idiomatic: Once copied on bamboo and spread through pipes and strings, they still could not escape Ji Xu's censure—who could expect the praise accorded "Sir Fantasy"?

sentences.zh: 迨今千載，不乏辭人，統論六義之源，較其三變之體，如二班者蓋寡，類七子者幾何？

translations.literal: Down to the present thousand years, literary men have not been lacking; surveying the source of the Six Principles and comparing their three transformations, those like the two Bans have been few, and those resembling the Seven Masters how many?
translations.idiomatic: A thousand years on, writers have never been scarce; yet surveying the source of the Six Principles and comparing their three transformations, how few have equaled the two Bans, how many resemble the Seven Masters?

sentences.zh: 至潘、陸情致之文，鮑、謝清便之作，迨於徐、庾，踵麗增華，纂組成而耀以珠璣，瑤臺構而間之金碧。

translations.literal: As for the feeling-laden writings of Pan and Lu, the clear and nimble works of Bao and Xie, down to Xu and Yu they followed in splendor and added ornament, brocade woven and adorned with pearls and jade, jade terraces built and interlaced with gold and azure.
translations.idiomatic: Pan and Lu wrote with feeling; Bao and Xie wrote with clarity and ease; by Xu and Yu splendor piled on splendor—brocade woven and studded with pearls, jade terraces framed in gold and azure.

sentences.zh: 國初開文館，高宗禮茂才，虞、許擅價於前，蘇、李馳聲於後。

translations.literal: At the founding of the state the Literary Hall was opened; in the Gaozong era eminent talent was honored; Yu and Xu set the price earlier, Su and Li spread their fame later.
translations.idiomatic: At the dynasty's founding the Literary Hall opened; under Gaozong eminent talent was honored; Yu and Xu set the standard early, Su and Li carried fame later.

sentences.zh: 或位升臺鼎，學際天人，潤色之文，鹹布編集。

translations.literal: Some rose to the highest offices, their learning reaching heaven and man; their polishing compositions were all distributed in collected editions.
translations.idiomatic: Some reached the highest offices with learning that touched heaven and man; their polishing compositions were gathered into collections.

sentences.zh: 然而向古者傷於太僻，徇華者或至不經，齷齪者局於宮商，放縱者流於鄭、衛。

translations.literal: Yet those who looked to antiquity were wounded by excessive eccentricity, those who followed ornament sometimes reached what was not canonical; the cramped were confined by pitch and mode, the unrestrained flowed into Zheng and Wey music.
translations.idiomatic: Those who looked to antiquity grew too eccentric; those who chased ornament sometimes left the canon; the cramped were trapped by pitch and mode, the unrestrained drifted into Zheng and Wey music.

sentences.zh: 若品調律度，揚搉古今，賢不肖皆賞其文，未如元、白之盛也。

translations.literal: If one grades tone and measure and weighs ancient and modern, so that worthy and unworthy all prized their writing, none matched the flourishing of Yuan and Bai.
translations.idiomatic: If one grades tone and measure and weighs past and present so that worthy and unworthy alike prize the writing, none has matched the ascendancy of Yuan and Bai.

sentences.zh: 昔建安才子，始定霸於曹、劉；

translations.literal: Of old the Jian'an talents first established hegemony for Cao and Liu;
translations.idiomatic: In Jian'an, literary talent first crowned Cao and Liu;

sentences.zh: 永明辭宗，先讓功於沈、謝。

translations.literal: the Yongming literary masters first yielded merit to Shen and Xie.
translations.idiomatic: in Yongming, the literary masters first yielded pride of place to Shen and Xie.

sentences.zh: 元和主盟，微之、樂天而已。

translations.literal: In the Yuanhe alliance, only Weizhi and Letian.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanhe literary league, only Weizhi and Letian held the field.

sentences.zh: 臣觀元之制策，白之奏議，極文章之壺奧，盡治亂之根荄。

translations.literal: Your subject observes Zhen's policy essays and Bai's memorials—they exhaust the innermost chamber of literature and lay bare the roots of order and disorder.
translations.idiomatic: This subject finds that Zhen's policy essays and Bai's memorials reach the innermost chamber of letters and lay bare the roots of order and disorder.

sentences.zh: 非徒謠頌之片言，盤盂之小說。

translations.literal: They are not mere fragments of ballad praise or trifling allegories on platters.
translations.idiomatic: These were not mere snatches of praise-song or little allegories on platters.

sentences.zh: 就文觀行，居易為優，放心於自得之場，置器於必安之地，優遊卒歲，不亦賢乎？

translations.literal: Judging conduct through writing, Juyi is superior; he set his heart in the field of self-contentment and placed his vessel in ground that must be secure—passing the years at ease, is this not worthy?
translations.idiomatic: Judging conduct by their writing, Juyi is the finer: he rested his heart where contentment lives and set his vessel on ground that must hold—passing his years at ease; is that not the better part?

sentences.zh: 贊曰：文章新體，建安、永明。

translations.literal: The eulogy says: New forms in literature—Jian'an, Yongming.
translations.idiomatic: The eulogy reads: New literary forms arose in Jian'an and Yongming.

sentences.zh: 沈、謝既往，元、白挺生。

translations.literal: Shen and Xie having passed, Yuan and Bai were born upright.
translations.idiomatic: After Shen and Xie, Yuan and Bai stood forth.

sentences.zh: 但留金石，長有《莖英》。

translations.literal: Only metal and stone remain; "Stalk and Blossom" endures forever.
translations.idiomatic: Metal and stone alone remain; "Stalk and Blossom" endures.

sentences.zh: 不習孫、吳，焉知用兵？

translations.literal: Without studying Sun and Wu, how can one know the use of arms?
translations.idiomatic: Without studying Sun and Wu, how could one know the use of arms?
